quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #16
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: You are waiting to turn left at a multilane intersection and opposing traffic is blocking your view. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up quickly when the first lane is clear.
Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before turning.
Wait for an oncoming driver to wave you across.
Move into each lane of opposing traffic as soon as it clears.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before turning.
questions.explanation: Never start a left turn until you can see that all the lanes you need to cross are clear and safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, they should:

options.text: Drive normally because emotions don't affect driving.
Drive faster because they are more alert.
Calm down and focus before starting to drive.
Call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down and focus before starting to drive.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can make it hard to drive safely because your mind is on other things instead of the road. Take time to calm down and get focused before you start driving.

questions.question: If a vehicle starts to skid on water, the driver should quickly apply the brakes.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids on water, try to regain control. If you can't, release the gas pedal and let the skid stop on its own. Do not apply the brakes right away.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow light, you should:
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light is a warning. Slow down and proceed carefully.

questions.question: Lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are divided by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes traveling in the same direction and mark the right edge of the road. Broken white lines can be crossed to pass. Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is false?

options.text: Winter is the hardest season to drive in.
Check antifreeze and windshield washer fluid levels during winter.
Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
Snow tires are best for winter driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow, rain, fog, or other hazardous conditions. Winter is the hardest driving season and requires extra care. Check antifreeze and windshield washer fluid often. Snow tires improve traction on slippery roads.

questions.question: Larger vehicles have:

options.text: The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.explanation: The bigger the vehicle, the bigger the blind spots. Large trucks and SUVs have areas near the rear that cannot be seen in side or rearview mirrors.

questions.question: The space you need to cross traffic depends on the:

options.text: Road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: The space you need to cross traffic depends on road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When driving in fog, what lights should you use?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog. You can also use fog lights if your vehicle has them. High beams point upward and bounce off fog, which makes it harder to see.

questions.question: How much lane space are motorcycles entitled to?

options.text: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to use the full width of a lane, just like all other vehicles.

questions.question: When driving from a private road or driveway, you do not have to stop before crossing a sidewalk.
questions.explanation: You must always stop your vehicle when entering a street or crossing a sidewalk from a driveway, alley, building, or parking lot.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Drive cautiously and reduce your speed.
Do not use high beam headlights.
Use low beam headlights to see the road and objects better.

questions.explanation: When driving in fog, drive slowly and carefully. Do not use high beams. Use low beams instead, as they light up the road and objects ahead better in foggy conditions.

questions.question: Why should you use extra caution when driving near a pedestrian with a white cane?

options.text: He or she is a police officer.
He or she has poor balance.

questions.explanation: A white cane means the person is blind. Slow down, give them the right-of-way, and be ready to stop. Be prepared to protect the pedestrian from danger.

questions.question: Drivers must always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road.
questions.explanation: You must always stop for a stopped school bus on a two-lane road, no matter which direction you are traveling. Always be careful around children.

questions.question: You are in an accident and someone is injured. What should you do?

options.text: Move the injured person away immediately.
Always leave the injured person where they are.
Do not move the injured person unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
Stay away from the injured person.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not move the injured person unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
questions.explanation: Do not move an injured person unless you must. Moving them can make injuries worse. Keep them warm until help arrives. If there is heavy bleeding, apply direct pressure to stop it.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the ignition.
Turn on your hazard lights and brace yourself.
Steer firmly, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: When power steering fails, steering will be harder. Slow down and carefully drive to a safe place to stop. Do not brake suddenly.

questions.question: What do round signs warn you about?
questions.explanation: Round signs warn drivers about railroad crossings ahead. Drive carefully and watch for trains when you see this sign.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer going 55 mph takes about how many feet to stop?
questions.explanation: Heavy trucks need much longer distances to stop than regular cars. A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph may need almost 400 feet to stop completely.

questions.question: Leave extra space between your vehicle and the one in front when stopping:
questions.explanation: Leave more space than usual when stopped on a hill. If the car in front rolls backward when traffic starts moving, extra space reduces the chance of a crash.

questions.question: This sign shape and color means a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This pennant-shaped sign is used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: When you see a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What is the main danger shown by this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher.
Your tire could be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You could lose control if your vehicle drifts onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if your vehicle drifts onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: It is safe to stop your vehicle on railroad tracks for a short time if you are moving with other cars.
questions.explanation: Never stop, stand, or park on railroad tracks. Always make sure your entire vehicle clears the tracks before stopping.

questions.question: You may not park:

options.text: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
Within 12 inches of the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane. When parking on the street, park within 12 inches of the edge of the road.

questions.question: "Highway hypnosis" happens when:

options.text: You stare at the road for a long time without looking around.
You sleep too much the night before driving.
You drive short trips on expressways.

questions.correctAnswerText: You stare at the road for a long time without looking around.
questions.explanation: Highway hypnosis happens when you stare straight ahead without scanning the road around you. You may zone out and miss traffic slowing or stopping in front of you, causing a crash.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a train crossing is ahead and to watch for approaching trains.

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the shoulder with no one inside.
When it approaches you, even if its lights are off.
On a two-lane highway when its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a two-lane highway when its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when a school bus shows flashing red lights while picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic from both directions must stop while the red lights are flashing and the stop arm is extended.

questions.question: When two drivers reach an open intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver may continue without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: If a vehicle arrives at an intersection to your right at the same time as you, yield to that vehicle. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools only.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is nearby.
Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow light mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A yellow light warns that a red light is coming. Slow down and prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection or cannot stop safely, continue through carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to dangerous conditions ahead. This sign warns drivers to be careful when wet conditions make the road slippery.
